51607693.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to 6-His-tagged human Aurora A (126 to 390 residues) expressed in Escherichia coli BL21 (DE3) cells assessed as dissociation constant by ITC analysis

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods - Isothermal Titra: Isothermal titration calorimetry (ITC) was performed using a Microcal iTC200 instrument at 25 °C, in the following experimental buffer (unless specifically indicated otherwise): 0.1 M HEPES/Na pH 7.4, 0.1 M magnesium acetate, 0.05 M NaCl, with the addition of 10% v/v DMSO, fresh 1 mM ATP and fresh 0.25 mM TCEP. Prior to the experiment, Aurora A protein was thawed and buffer exchanged in the experimental buffer using NAP-5 Columns (GE Healthcare). Experiments typically involved titrating 25 μM protein in the sample cell with 300 μM compound in the syringe. The raw ITC data were fitted using a single site binding model using the Microcal ITC LLC data analysis program in the Origin 7.0 package.
original_paragraph.Figure 3 caption - ITC data: Isothermal titration calorimetry titration of compound 8 to Aurora A (left) and to Aurora B (right).
original_paragraph.Figure 3F description: The ITC thermograms for compound 8 binding to Aurora A and Aurora B are shown in Figure 3F. The binding isotherms were fitted to a single-site binding model, yielding a Kd of 100 nM for Aurora A and 100 μM for Aurora B, indicating a >1000-fold selectivity for Aurora A over Aurora B.

assay_conditions.buffer_composition: 0.1 M HEPES/Na, 0.1 M magnesium acetate, 0.05 M NaCl, 10% v/v DMSO, 1 mM ATP, 0.25 mM TCEP
